notes.title: Improvements update
notes.content:
Today we have released a new build with improvement such as:


  New Tutorial Level
  "A Great Escape" level is now battle exclusive instead of Tutorial
  New enemies and HP added to "A Great Escape"
  Improved Environment Lights Effects
  Removing the sliding movement on "A Great Escape"
  Added activation of Protocolos of shooting, shields, jetpack, and bullet-time using collectibles
  New sensitivity system for gamepad
  Minor bugs fixing

notes.title: Fans' suggestions are becoming a reality
notes.content:
During the last weeks, we designed the new PixelArt of "LAST SOUL" live on Twitch and now your suggestions are becoming part of our game.

It has always been our goal to create "LAST SOUL" listening to the feedback and requests of our followers. At every step of the development, we're promoting new content to know the thoughts from outside. It's essential for us to keep this constant communication and get feedback to confirm that what we're doing feels right. And if we have to change direction, we can always ask for ideas.

Based on your excitement of the current Art, we're moving forward with the next levels of the game. Our final goal is to have a game with a least 40 different levels. Now, the most waiting levels are on the go: Level 2 and 3. Here, BOP gets to earth looking for SUP. What will come next it's a secret that you'll discover very soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39573845/1b8d06901b302ce791e4d53e133383a838eb6d90.png

Remember to Wishlist And Follow the Final Version
The support from our fans continues. But we still have a long path ahead of us. That's why we remember you to Wishlist and Follow the Final Version of "LAST SOUL." Remember that this version new version is not the prologue. We're creating a totally new game that we'll be released in 2022, and we starting our growing campaign of followers from this moment.

You're part of our creation. Please, remember to Wishlist and Follow "LAST SOUL" final release.

notes.title: Fixing bugs, improving performance, and small extra for SpeedRunners!
notes.content:
After more than 10,000 gamers in less than three weeks, you showed us that we're on the right track. Thanks for your amazing support.

For this event, we'll release a new version of the Two Demo Levels you already love including:

Correcting Typos on the dialogues
Changing keyboard movement to WASD and Up, Down, Left, and Right so you can pick your favorite
Changing features to be controlled on IJKL keyboard buttons.
Red CB-Trooper has a new feature you'll discover
Fixing error on the end of the Tutorial Level
Added a credit's section


And beyond the previously mentioned fixings, and after seeing a lot of streamers challenging each other on Twitter and Discord, we're adding a timer they can use to brag about their record. We know you all will enjoy it.
